name: gitlab-self-hosted
description: Inspect and operate GitLab projects through the hosted GitLab Self-Hosted MCP endpoint with remote HTTPS OAuth by default, while retaining an explicit localhost development fallback.

interface.shortDescription: GitLab MCP over hosted HTTPS + OAuth
interface.longDescription: Install the GitHub marketplace root and use GitLab immediately through the bundled direct MCP binding to https://gitlab-mcp.blacmarcs.com/mcp. The MCP client performs OAuth discovery and GitLab authorization over remote HTTPS; users do not need to run the MCP server locally, build a generated marketplace variant, or maintain a second repository. A localhost-bound generated variant remains available only as a development fallback. The distinct gitlab-self-hosted identifier avoids collision with the OpenAI-curated GitLab plugin.
defaultPrompt: List the GitLab groups and projects I can access.
Review the current GitLab merge request and address feedback.
Create a GitLab issue or merge request after confirming the target.
